metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 for up to 2048 nonpadding item embeddings, sampled without replacement with seed 42. About 0.5 means near-zero mean cosine; higher means greater directional alignment. This alone does not measure ranking quality, recommendation diversity or representation rank. Null means unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score using mixed log2feats features in eval mode, over positions with nonzero sequence, positive and negative IDs in up to ten training batches. Uses the loader's negative distribution; not final-position HR@10.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile, rank ceil(0.1*N), of the same training-position margins.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of the same training positions with margin < 0; ties are excluded.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of the same training positions with margin < 0.5; depends on score scale.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Explicit category unavailability plus measured batch/position counts and margin counts when available. No item categories or dataset macro scores are inferred.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unavailable_probes: Reasons for unavailable probes, including explicit errors. Null numeric metrics indicate missing measurements, not zero values. No validation improvement or subjective acceptance is estimated. Module modes and global Python, NumPy, Torch CPU and model-device CUDA random streams are restored. Loader iteration and loader-owned generators are consumed; use a separate diagnostic loader to avoid changing subsequent training batches.
